name: Bento Flip Gallery
description: Pinned bento grid of eight photos that expands on scroll into a full-screen grid using a GSAP Flip transition, followed by an editorial text section with heading, details, quote and columns.
contents: Editorial section with heading, detail list, lead paragraph, pull quote and two-column paragraphs
behavior: Scroll-scrubbed GSAP Flip morph from small bento tiles to large grid cells
Gallery is pinned while the scrub runs
Drop cap and sticky heading in the text section

props.name: leadParagraph
props.default: I shot this roll over a single weekend in late autumn, mostly at dusk, when the light was too thin for anything but a wide aperture and a steady breath. Ten exposures went in. Eight came out the other side.

props.name: pullQuote
props.default: Most of what I keep is what I almost missed.

editableByProps: Images, heading, all text, details and quote
Ink, paper and accent colors, fonts
Grid sizes, gap, scrub start, distance, ease and pinning

needsCodeEdit.change: Change number of grid columns or rows
needsCodeEdit.where: grid-template-columns classes on the gallery element

fixed: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger pin on the gallery parent
Loads Bodoni Moda and Newsreader from Google Fonts via link tags
Layout supports up to eight images placed by AREAS
